tokens.name: disc-950
tokens.usage: Deepest disc black: the solid ledge under every raised block, the countdown and pause scrims.

tokens.name: disc-900
tokens.usage: Full-screen menu ground and the HUD plate (at `hud-plate` opacity over the sky); also `ink`, the text colour on bright faces.

tokens.name: disc-800
tokens.usage: Panel face: menu card, lobby columns, options, pause, results. cream 15.9:1, sand 10.7:1, dust 6.4:1.

tokens.name: disc-700
tokens.usage: Raised face inside a panel: rows, fields, dropdowns, HUD cards, held/next slots. cream 14.0:1, sand 9.5:1, dust 5.6:1.

tokens.name: disc-600
tokens.usage: Secondary block face (Join, Options, Back, Add bot), hovered rows. cream 11.8:1, sand 7.9:1, dust 4.7:1.

tokens.name: disc-500
tokens.usage: Secondary face on hover; empty bar tracks; off toggle knobs; the locked timer ring.

tokens.name: disc-400
tokens.usage: Visible control edges: field, dropdown and checkbox outlines, dividers. 3.0:1 on disc-800 — the floor for a control border.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on any disc surface; the 3px focus outline.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Secondary text: setting values, descriptions, roster sub-lines, table cells.

tokens.name: dust
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: field labels, table headers, captions, key-prompt words; 13px+ and bold below 16px. 4.7:1 on disc-600, 4.3:1 on the HUD plate over the brightest sky.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons ON a bright face (flare, rim, mint, any player colour): 4.5:1 or better on all of them. Never cream on a bright face.

tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: THE primary action: Play, Host, Start match, Resume, Play again, Ready. One flare block per screen. Ink label (6.0:1).

tokens.name: flare-top
tokens.usage: Lit top edge of a flare block.

tokens.name: flare-lip
tokens.usage: Dark lower lip of a flare block; the pressed face.

tokens.name: rim
tokens.usage: The disc's glowing gold rim, brought into the UI: active tab notch, selected chip edge, timer warning, reward callouts, GO. Ink on it (11.9:1). Never a second primary button.

tokens.name: rim-lip
tokens.usage: Lower lip of a rim-gold block.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Positive state: ready, enabled gift/special chips, connected, flag captured. Ink on it (9.0:1). Always with ✓ or a word.

tokens.name: mint-lip
tokens.usage: Lower lip of a mint block.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Negative feedback: placement rejected, kick, connection lost, eliminated. Always with ✕ or ! and a word.

tokens.name: locked
tokens.usage: Timer ring and next card while the fixed-interval release lock holds; label reads LOCKED.

tokens.name: player-1
tokens.usage: Slot 1 (red) — MatchConfig.player_colors[0], the colour of that player's blocks, territory, beacon and HUD marker. Ink on it, not cream. Red, blue and purple share a lightness: show the player's diamond marker (with its slot mark in colour-assist) wherever colour identifies them.

styles.name: countdown
styles.usage: Pre-match 3-2-1 and GO, centred on a disc-950 scrim. GO in rim.

styles.name: logo
styles.usage: Wordmark beside the cube mark; cream with a 4px disc-600 drop.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Results screen shares and the winner's number.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Feed-timer seconds in the top-centre ring.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Block button labels, uppercase, one or two words.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Compact block buttons in rows and roster entries, uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drop blocks inside your territory to grow it.
styles.usage: Descriptions, tutorial text, setting values. Sentence case.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: HUD card labels, setting names, tab names, uppercase. dust or sand on disc.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Ping, counts, hints. Never for a decision the player must make.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between voxel cells in the mark, share segments and chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; padding inside chips and keycaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked block buttons is space-3 + the 6px drop; padding inside HUD cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; gap between peer controls; panel row gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding; HUD inset from the screen edge at 1080p.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panel groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Menu column inset from the screen edge; logo to first button.

tokens.name: radius-cell
tokens.usage: Voxel cells: the mark, territory segments, next-piece cells, slot glyph tiles.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Player chips, keycaps, badges, toggle knobs.

tokens.name: radius-block
tokens.usage: Block buttons, fields, HUD cards, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels and dialogs — the largest radius; nothing in Stackfall is a pill.

depth.note: Every raised surface is a block: a lit top edge, a dark lower lip, and a solid drop onto disc-950. Pressing removes the drop and moves the face down by the same amount.

tokens.name: lip
tokens.usage: Dark inner bottom edge of a block button (the face's -lip color).

tokens.name: lip-sm
tokens.usage: Lip on compact buttons, chips, keycaps and HUD cards.

tokens.name: top
tokens.usage: Lit inner top edge of a block.

tokens.name: drop
tokens.usage: Solid ledge under a block button; the face translates down this much when pressed.

tokens.name: drop-sm
tokens.usage: Ledge under compact blocks and HUD cards.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Snow focus outline width, offset 3px outside the block (inside the drop).

tokens.name: shadow-block
tokens.usage: Generic block on any face color: lip, top light and drop in one.

tokens.name: shadow-block-sm
tokens.usage: Compact blocks, chips, keycaps, HUD cards.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed block: no drop, shallow lip.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Sunken fields, tracks and lists: shadow at the top edge, no drop.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels floating over the 3D scene.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: disc-900 scrim behind the left menu column (fading to 0 by 62% of the width) and behind pause/results dialogs (full screen).

tokens.name: hud-plate
tokens.usage: disc-900 plate behind every HUD group (scoreboard, held/next, tip banner, minimap) so text holds on a peach day sky and a navy night alike.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled blocks: whole block at this opacity, ledge removed.
